messages:
Priya: quick ask 1010 need aligned assets for next week's benchmark webinar + three launch posts. Deliverables: single-slide benchmark narrative (hero + 3 tiles), a 30s gif for social showing p95 drop, three headline variants, and an export-ready slide template for sales. can someone own design? deadline Wed EOD.

Theo: i can own design. pairing with Marco for charts. do we want the tiles to include raw numbers or % change only?

Priya: include both but make raw numbers small (footnote). main stat should be percent improvement. avoid absolute "fastest" language.

Renee: marketing copy: need 3 tone variants: technical (for eng blog), product (for webinar), and concise (social). i'll drop copy files in drive.

DesignBot: figma created -> https://redwood.app/figma/bench-narrative-1773000456 (components: narrative-hero, bench-tile, gif-timeline). export tokens preloaded (SVG, PNG@3x, GIF).

Marco: uploading perf CSV now. charts should show NA/EU/APAC lines + p95 annotations. i'll include a small data-source column.

Theo: for the gif i want a subtle animate of the sparkline + percentage popping. any brand motion guidelines?

Priya: use existing motion kit (link in drive). keep it subtle and 3s loop. also provide a static fallback for email.

SalesOps: template note: the slide needs a small area for customer logo (left) and a single-line takeaway sales can edit. also provide a muted-color variant for co-branding.

LegalOps: please add data-source footnote and avoid competitor comparisons. i'll need final copy 24h before publish.

Theo: export spec planned: hero 1920x1080 PNG@2x, tiles SVG + PNG@2x, social GIF 1080x1080 @30fps max 3s, and slide template PPTX with editable fields.

Renee: putting copy drafts here: 

```
Technical: "p95 latency reduced by ~45% across production workloads; serving unit cost down ~30%."
Product: "Inference costs fall, latency improves  making real-time features cheaper to ship."
Social: "Serving wins: 45% faster p95, 30% cheaper."
```

Marco: note on data: numbers are computed from 7-day rolling medians. will attach CSV: https://files.redwood/bench_177300_data.csv. use \u2248 for approximations.

Theo: adding alt-text suggestions in figma notes and will run contrast checks. any localization scope?

Priya: we need EN/FR/DE/JA. Marco please add column for short-context strings so translators have context.

DesignBot: translations layer prepared in figma (text styles linked to tokens).

Theo: draft uploads scheduled Tue evening. quick export snippet for the ops team: 

```
# batch export (from figma API)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/figma/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIGMA_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"file":"bench-narrative-1773000456","formats":["png@2x","svg","gif"]}'
```

Renee: small ask for social headlines: can we test two CTA flavors? "Register" vs "See the numbers". i'll A/B with our comms team.

SalesOps: thanks 44d also need a plain text one-liner for the sales email.

Theo: noted. will include a plain-text readme with filenames and one-liners. naming convention: bench_narr_EN_v1.png, bench_gif_EN_v1.gif, slide_template_v1.PPTX.

Priya: perfect. ping me if anything blocks. Marco, drop the CSV and i'll validate numbers with product before publication. :sparkles:
